channel.title: AI News Radar - Frontier AI Intel, Social Signals & Tools
channel.description: Real-time panoramic intelligence radar for global frontier AI breakthroughs, verified leader signals, hands-on tutorials, and applied developer tools.

item.title: AI industry growth remains strong, but the pace is slowing
item.description: Ramp AI Index and OpenRouter data indicate that US corporate AI usage is hitting record highs while the average cost per million tokens has dropped below $0.45 due to aggressive pricing competition. Anthropic has surpassed OpenAI in both spending and volume market share, signaling a paradigm shift in the AI infrastructure market from a high-premium phase to a defensive pricing cycle.

item.title: A bipartisan group of 24+ House lawmakers forms the AI Safety and Innovation Caucus, seeking to balance mitigating AI risks with maintaining US leadership in AI (Owen Dahlkamp/Politico)
item.description: Over 24 bipartisan House lawmakers, led by Representatives George Whitesides, Don Beyer, and Nathaniel Moran, have formed the AI Safety and Innovation Caucus. The group aims to serve as an active legislative conduit, bridging the gap between long-term policy formulation and rapid-response requirements by leveraging cross-sector intelligence to address AI-related incidents and security breaches.

item.title: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you
item.description: Google has introduced 'Computer Use' capabilities to its Gemini desktop application on macOS, enabling the AI agent to navigate native apps, manage local files, and browse the web on the user's behalf. This feature is gated behind Gemini Plus, Pro, or Ultra subscriptions and is currently limited to English users in the U.S., requiring explicit user approval for agentic actions via a live preview interface.

item.title: Former Alibaba exec’s Everful raises $48.5M to connect retailers with Chinese factories
item.description: Everful, a cross-border supply chain platform co-founded by former Alibaba executive Sisi Song and serial entrepreneur Kevin Han, raised $48.5 million in Series A funding led by Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia & India. The company leverages an AI-enabled platform to connect over 30,000 factories with small retailers, providing end-to-end services including sourcing, quality control, and logistics, achieving an annualized revenue of $100 million.

item.title: Gemini on Mac can now use your computer
item.description: Google has introduced the "Computer Use" feature to its Gemini app for macOS, enabling the AI to execute multi-step tasks across local files, desktop applications, and the web. Currently rolling out in the US, the feature allows users to designate app access while monitoring AI actions through a real-time background preview window.

item.title: Ubisoft Logs Strong Bookings as Players Welcome Assassin’s Creed Remake
item.description: Ubisoft Singapore's 'Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced' achieved 3.5 million sales within two weeks, accompanied by recent New Game+ and difficulty updates. Jean Guesdon, Head of AC Content, confirmed in the Fall 2026 Update that no further remakes are in development, with resources redirected to 'Codename Invictus' and the mainline 'Codename Hexe'.

item.title: Alphabet to Raise at Least $3.5 Billion With Canadian Debt Sale
item.description: Alphabet Inc. is planning to raise at least CA$5 billion through a five-part bond sale in the Canadian market, marking its return just six months after its inaugural CA$8.5 billion offering in May. The move is designed to leverage regional liquidity to optimize the company's global treasury and capital structure.

item.title: London-based Boltz, which is developing AI models to speed up drug discovery, raised a $110M Series A led by Bessemer, after raising a $28M seed in 2025 (John Reynolds/Tech.eu)
item.description: Boltz, an AI drug discovery startup spun out of MIT and now based in London, has raised $110 million in Series A funding led by Bessemer Venture Partners. The capital injection follows a $28 million seed round in 2025 and will be utilized to accelerate the development of its AI models for accelerated pharmaceutical research.

item.title: Chinese tech firms face a double hit as chip shipments stop and overseas cloud access disappears
item.description: The U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) has tightened export controls by requiring licenses for AI compute access in third-party countries, effectively closing cloud loopholes. Simultaneously, TSMC and Samsung have halted shipments of advanced processors to certain Chinese clients pending license approval, forcing firms like Moonshot AI to cancel major compute contracts and triggering widespread supply chain disruption.

item.title: Google Built a Giant ‘Mirror Dimension’ Internet to Test Its Chrome AI Agents
item.description: Google's Chrome AI team has developed a controlled, expansive simulation environment dubbed the 'Mirror Dimension.' This sandbox hosts realistic versions of social media, e-commerce, and banking platforms, allowing researchers to evaluate the resilience of Gemini-powered web-browsing agents against prompt-injection attacks and other real-world vulnerabilities without risking the open web.

item.title: Anthropic's historic debut to put AI's promise and peril to Wall St test
item.description: Nov 19 (Reuters) - Anthropic's record $81 billion IPO brings to Wall Street an avatar of a sector that proponents herald as an economic panacea, while detractors warn it has stoked a market bubble and could ultimately threaten humanity itself. More immediately, the Claude chatbot maker's debut after securing a $1.5 trillion valuation in the IPO, together with Tuesday's earnings report by AI poster child Nvidia, signals the industry has nominally passed the two big tests facing it this week. The listing comes nearly a month after Anthropic revealed its plans to go public. item.title: AMD Slides After Hunterbrook Shorts Stock, Cites Circular Deals
item.description: Short-selling firm Hunterbrook alleged that AMD continued providing BIOS firmware updates to IEIT Systems, a Chinese server manufacturer blacklisted by the U.S. in March 2025. While the report stopped short of proving a legal violation, the allegation triggered market concerns over AMD's supply chain traceability and compliance efficacy, causing an 8% drop in its share price.

item.title: Amazon warns NYC customers they face price hikes up to $5 for every order if delivery bill is passed
item.description: Amazon customers in New York City will be charged up to $5 more per order if the local government passes a controversial bill aimed at cracking down on employment practices for “last-mile” delivery drivers, the e-tail giant is warning. Amazon is appealing directly to its Big Apple customers in its fight against the legislation, The Post has learned. Starting Thursday, they will see messages on Amazon’s website and app warning of higher costs if the bill passes. Amazon is also urging customers

item.title: Binance Secures $6.5 Billion Freezing Order From Abu Dhabi Court
item.description: Binance announced the court action on November 18, saying its legal representatives had identified approximately 26,000 cryptocurrency wallet addresses associated with stolen assets. The exchange plans to maintain an updated list as investigators trace funds moving between wallets and blockchains. The injunction follows an attack that Binance valued at approximately $6.34 billion. The company previously reported that about $2.85 billion had been frozen or intercepted, leaving substantial assets

item.title: Seattle-based StepSecurity, which offers a software supply chain security platform, raised a $20M Series A led by Elephant, bringing its total funding to $23M (Chris Metinko/Axios)
item.description: Seattle-based software supply chain security platform StepSecurity has raised $20 million in Series A funding led by Elephant, bringing its total funding to $23 million. The capital will be utilized to bolster its automated, real-time security solutions for CI/CD pipelines and the software development lifecycle.

item.title: ChatGPT can transcribe as you speak now with Live Dictation
item.description: OpenAI has officially launched the 'Live Dictation' feature across all ChatGPT platforms (Web, Desktop, iOS, and Android), enabling real-time text transcription as users speak. Additionally, OpenAI has removed the previous 10-minute recording limit for voice dictation to enhance reliability and efficiency in handling long-form audio input.

item.title: Anthropic IPO Said to Give Nothing to Most Institutional Buyers
item.description: Artificial intelligence company Anthropic has successfully debuted on the Nasdaq. With a share price of $83, the company's valuation exceeds $1.4 trillion, placing it among the ten most valuable firms in the U.S. This IPO has triggered an unprecedented wave of wealth creation, with approximately 400 early employees valued at over $100 million each and seven founders holding stakes worth roughly $20 billion each, expected to significantly impact the San Francisco real estate and philanthropic sectors.

item.title: The European Commission confirms a cyberattack that disrupted systems for 10+ days; CERT-EU says international hackers used AI penetration testing tool ARTEX (Gerardo Fortuna/Politico)
item.description: The European Commission suffered a major cyberattack that crippled key administrative systems, including payroll and leave management, for over 10 days. CERT-EU confirmed that international hackers leveraged the AI-powered penetration testing tool ARTEX to exploit system vulnerabilities, with the extent of data compromise and system damage still under ongoing assessment.

item.title: With the biggest IPO of all time, Anthropic’s ‘good guy’ reputation is on the line
item.description: AI lab Anthropic has completed the largest-ever IPO in history, raising $81.3 billion. Operating as a Public Benefit Corporation, the company utilizes a unique Long-Term Benefit Trust (LTBT) structure to retain voting control, aiming to navigate the inherent tension between aggressive AI development and its foundational commitment to safety.

item.title: UK loses bid to keep Apple ‘backdoor’ order secret
item.description: The UK Investigatory Powers Tribunal has ruled that the UK Home Office must acknowledge the issuance of secret technical capability notices to Apple. These notices aimed to compel Apple to bypass end-to-end encryption to facilitate government access, with the tribunal's ruling serving to address concerns over the lack of transparency in government surveillance practices.

item.title: Anthropic's $81.3 billion IPO shatters SpaceX's record as rising rates and political headwinds shake the sector
item.description: AI startup Anthropic has completed its Nasdaq IPO, raising $81.3 billion and surpassing SpaceX's record, with a fully diluted market cap of approximately $1.5 trillion. Despite revenue surging 1,200% year-over-year to $33.24 billion in the first nine months, net losses widened to $104 billion due to the revaluation of convertible notes and derivative liabilities.

item.title: Blue Origin will launch Google’s AI server satellites in 2029
item.description: Google is teaming up with Jeff Bezos’ Blue Origin to launch its AI server satellites. The companies announced on Thursday that Blue Origin’s New Glenn rocket will shuttle satellites equipped with Google’s Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) into space in the first quarter of 2029. The partnership is part of Google’s Project Suncatcher, a moonshot plan that could eventually put AI data centers in space. This week, the National Institutes of Health announced that it is releasing its final group of research chimps to a 200-acre forested federal sanctuary in Keithville, Louisiana. item.title: ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ Debut Spurs Livestream Influencer Marathons
item.description: Take-Two Interactive's Rockstar Games released Grand Theft Auto VI, triggering an unprecedented traffic surge on Twitch with 3.3 million concurrent viewers. Financial models project the title to surpass $3 billion in revenue within its initial months based on current pre-order demand and community engagement.

item.title: Temu Owner Reports Flat Profit, Revenue as Challenges Continue
item.description: PDD Holdings reported a 0.7% YoY net profit increase to 29.54 billion yuan with flat revenue. The company faces significant headwinds as its overseas platform, Temu, encounters severe scrutiny from the European Commission over content moderation and illegal product sanctions, compounded by cooling domestic consumer demand.

item.title: OpenAI's own researchers now say they value their AI tools more than nearly half their colleagues
item.description: OpenAI's internal report reveals a massive surge in the use of autonomous agents for R&D, with theoretical compute costs now exceeding base researcher salaries at $2,400 per person per day. While agents show a 79% success rate in routine monitoring, they remain significantly constrained in complex engineering and scaffolding tasks.

item.title: I let Apple’s always-listening AI summarize my life for two weeks
item.description: I’ve been asking myself this quite a bit over the last month or so while testing both the Amazon Bee Frontier and Siri Recap on the Apple Watch Ultra 4. Both enable a wearable to ambiently listen to your conversations and, using AI, summarize them for you. Why? So you can remember better and, hopefully, stay more present.
